coverage: Multi-byte UTF8 and oversized single-line text lossless bounded reconstruction
Prefer whole lines; JSONL complete-line publication and immutable append prefix; truncate partial UTF8 final writer line before decode
No binary opens; allowlisted symlink rejected
Fixed source/chunk mutation rejected; dynamic status snapshots allowed
Small-to-large fixed source cannot bypass immutability
limitations: Text publication validates metadata and complete JSONL prefixes, not scientific quality or native numerical correctness.
If a recoverable training rollback changes an already exported prefix, this tool rejects rather than silently rewrites it; a separately recorded publication transition is required.
Evaluation observations exported only when written by the native completed evaluation; no inference or tensor/PNG/MP4 access.
